premise: Ladybug cannot count her own spots; Mouse counts fast and gets nine, Snail counts slow and gets six; counting together, one by one, they find seven, and a dewdrop pretending.
inspiration: The Blind Men and the Elephant (folk), turned kind: each friend sees a piece, nobody argues, and counting together adds up.

en-US.title: Ladybug Counts Her Spots
en-US.text: {ladybug:float loop 0.3} [curious] How many spots does Ladybug have? Ladybug {ladybug:pulse} did not know. She turned round to look. {ladybug:spin} {sfx:whirr} The spots turned too. She turned faster. {ladybug:spin x2} Faster! Oh dear. Now she was dizzy. Mouse {mouse:hop} came to help. I count fast, he said. [rushed] One-two-three-four-five-six-seven-eight-NINE! Nine? said Ladybug. Snail {snail:pulse} came to help. I count slowly, he said. [slowly] One… two… three… four… five… six. Six? said Ladybug. Then Flower {flower:wobble} said, Why not count together? So they did. Mouse pointed, Snail counted, Ladybug held very still. One. Two. Three. Four. Five. Six. Seven. And… [surprised] number eight was not a spot at all. It was a drop of dew, sitting on her back, pretending. {sfx:plip} Plip! Off it rolled. [laughs] Seven, said everyone. Seven spots, and one very cheeky dewdrop. [happily] And Ladybug never had to turn round again.

es-ES.title: Mariquita cuenta sus puntos
es-ES.text: {ladybug:float loop 0.3} [curious] ¿Cuántos puntos tiene Mariquita? Mariquita {ladybug:pulse} no lo sabía. Se dio la vuelta para mirar. {ladybug:spin} {sfx:whirr} Los puntos también se dieron la vuelta. Giró más rápido. {ladybug:spin x2} ¡Más rápido! Ay. Ahora estaba mareada. Ratón {mouse:hop} vino a ayudar. Yo cuento rápido, dijo. [rushed] ¡Uno-dos-tres-cuatro-cinco-seis-siete-ocho-NUEVE! ¿Nueve?, dijo Mariquita. Caracol {snail:pulse} vino a ayudar. Yo cuento despacio, dijo. [slowly] Uno… dos… tres… cuatro… cinco… seis. ¿Seis?, dijo Mariquita. Entonces Flor {flower:wobble} dijo: ¿Y si contáis juntos? Y eso hicieron. Ratón señalaba, Caracol contaba, Mariquita se quedó muy quieta. Uno. Dos. Tres. Cuatro. Cinco. Seis. Siete. Y… [surprised] el número ocho no era un punto. Era una gota de rocío, sentada en su espalda, haciéndose pasar por punto. {sfx:plip} ¡Plic! Y rodó al suelo. [laughs] Siete, dijeron todos. Siete puntos y una gota muy pilla. [happily] Y Mariquita no tuvo que volver a darse la vuelta nunca más.

whirr.prompt: a ladybug's tiny wings whirring as it spins on the spot, a short comic buzz

plip.prompt: a single dewdrop rolling off and landing on a leaf, one small bright plip
